rocket.name: Falcon 9

thrust_sl_n.source_quote: Thrust at sea Level	7,607 kN / 1,710,000 lbf

ambiguities: The document describes multiple variants (v1.0, v1.1, Full Thrust/Block 3, Block 4, Block 5). No specific variant was named in the user message. The 'Specifications' section tables (first stage, second stage) appear to correspond to the current Block 5 variant based on context, but the document does not explicitly label those tables as Block 5.

The second-stage thrust is listed simply as 'Thrust' with no sea-level or vacuum qualifier in the section header, but it is described as a '1 vacuum' Merlin engine and the Isp is labeled 'Specific Impulse (vacuum)', so this thrust value is treated as vacuum thrust.
The second-stage Isp is labeled only 'Specific Impulse (vacuum)'; no sea-level Isp is provided for the second stage, as expected for a vacuum-optimized engine.
LEO payload capacity of 22,800 kg is listed for Full Thrust Block 3/4 and '≥ 22,800 kg (expendable)' for Block 5; the value used here is from the Block 5 column as the most current active variant.
The document states 'Every Merlin engine produces 854 kN (192,000 lbf) of thrust' without specifying sea-level or vacuum context, so this per-engine figure was not used in the extraction.
